description_en: Invites a customer to register as a partner customer
description_zh: 邀请注册成为伙伴客户
kebab_example: aliyun agency invite-sub-account --account-info-list SubAccountType=1 CustomerBd=张三 ZeroCreditShutdownPolicy=1 CreditLine=100 NewBuyStatus=ban CustomerId=1234567 EmailAddress=12345@163.com AccountNickname=XXX技术有限公司 Remark=发展xx为客户的邀请 --api-version 2022-12-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InviteSubAccount

fields.help_en:
The name of the distribution customer. Valid values:
If the distribution customer is an enterprise, this is the company name.
If the distribution customer is a T2 reseller partner, this is the partner name
fields.help_zh:
分销客户的名称:
当是分销客户是一家企业时，为企业的公司名称
当是分销客户是T2 reseller伙伴时，为伙伴名称
fields.name: account_nickname

fields.help_en: The total budget quota that the partner allocates to the distribution customer
fields.help_zh: 伙伴分配给分销客户的总预算额度(quota)
fields.name: credit_line

fields.help_en: The account manager of the customer. Maximum length: 50 characters
fields.name: customer_bd

fields.help_en: The customer ID returned by the CreateCustomer API
fields.help_zh: Customer Id 从CreateCustomer API返回的
fields.name: customer_id

fields.help_en: The email address of the distribution customer account. The invitation email is sent to this address
fields.help_zh: 分销客户账户的邮件地址，要发送邀请邮件到这里
fields.name: email_address

fields.help_en:
The initial order placement status. Valid values:

ban: Purchase is prohibited. After the customer is registered and associated, the customer cannot immediately place orders to purchase cloud resources. You must set the order control to normal before the customer can place orders.
normal: Normal. After the customer is registered and associated, the customer can immediately place orders to purchase cloud resources
fields.help_zh:
初始下单状态：

ban：禁购--客户注册关联成功后不可立即下单购买云资源，需要在后续将“下单控制”配置为“正常”才可以下单。
normal：正常--客户注册关联成功后可立即下单购买云资源
fields.name: new_buy_status

fields.help_en: The description of the distribution customer
fields.name: remark

fields.help_en:
The type of the sub-account. Valid values:
1: end user of Agency.
2: end user of Reseller. 
5: T2 partner of Reseller
fields.help_zh:
子账号类型:
1: Agency 的 End user
2: Reseller 的End user 
5: Reseller 的T2伙伴
fields.name: sub_account_type

fields.help_en:
The shutdown policy that the partner manages for the distribution customer. Valid values:

1: delayStop. Alibaba Cloud takes over the resources and the customer enjoys a delayed shutdown quota. When the delayed shutdown quota is exhausted, instance shutdown is triggered. If payment is not made within 15 days, storage resources are released.
2: noStop. Manual management with no shutdown on overdue payment. The system does not manage the resource lifecycle of the non-trusteeship linked account. The partner must manually manage the instance shutdown status of the customer.
3: immediatelyStop. Instances are immediately shut down on overdue payment. When the available quota of the customer account is less than 0, the account enters the overdue payment status and instance shutdown is triggered
fields.help_zh:
伙伴对分销客户的停机策略管理。

1: delayStop 享受延停额度延迟停机：阿里云接管资源，延停额度耗尽是触发实例停机，再15天还未付费，则会释放存储资源。
2: noStop手工管理欠费不停机,：系统不会管理子账号的资源生命周期。伙伴需要手工管理客户的实例停机状态。 
3：immediatelyStop  欠费立停，客户账号可用额度小于0账号进入欠费状态触发实例停机
fields.name: zero_credit_shutdown_policy

parameters.help_en: The list of account information for the invitation. A maximum of five accounts can be invited at a time
parameters.help_zh: 邀请账号信息列表，一次小于等于5个
parameters.name: account_info_list

Code.description_en:
The fault code. Valid values:
200: OK.
1109: System Error
Code.description_zh:
错误代码: 
200 OK
1109 System Error

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud uses this ID for fault tracking
RequestId.description_zh: request ID，阿里云会根据这个进行错误跟踪

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the current API invocation is successful. Valid values: True and False. This does not indicate whether the subsequent business operation is successful
Success.description_zh: 候选值:True/False，代表了是否当前API调用本身是成功 的。不代表后续业务操作的成功
